answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cannot grade until they earn reputation through verifiable work, and each round samples a random quorum from that pool. A fake-identity attacker must pay to build real standing for every identity, then still needs most of the quorum to collude, risking slashing of that stake. Like a violet in a meadow, a sybil stands out from a fable of forged peers, because honest quorums converge while collusion produces outliers that cost the attacker everything.
